# aidial Provider

Terraform provider for [EPAM AI DIAL Core](https://github.com/epam/ai-dial-core): manage roles, keys, models and routes as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aidial = {
      source = "epam/aidial"
    }
  }
}

provider "aidial" {
  base_url = "https://dial-core.example.com"
  api_key  = var.aidial_api_key
}

variable "aidial_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) DIAL API key sent in the Api-Key header.
- `base_url` (String) DIAL API base URL, for example http://IP:PORT or https://IP:PORT.
